title: Aegis: A Conversational Prototype for Lung Cancer Risk Information and Follow-up
abstract: arXiv:2611.28642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collecting self-reported risk information and maintaining continuity between assessment, explanation, and follow-up are practical components of a lung cancer screening workflow. We present Aegis, a browser-based research prototype that combines a conversational questionnaire, rule-based risk categorization, downloadable reports, retrieval-augmented health information, and doctor-user communication. A session-oriented controller manages question progression and clarification, while a language model assists with answer validation. Structured responses are passed to a separate risk-analysis module, and reports are linked to user and session records through Firebase services. The project adopts a multi-agent design that separates information collection, validation, assessment, and report generation. Its documented verification scope comprises 45 functional test specifications covering account management, questionnaire interaction, reporting,

translated_title: Aegis：面向肺癌风险信息与随访的对话式原型系统
translated_abstract: 收集自述的风险信息，并在评估、解释与随访之间保持连续性，是肺癌筛查工作流程中的实用环节。我们提出了Aegis，这是一个基于浏览器的研究原型，它集成了对话式问卷、基于规则的风险分类、可下载报告、检索增强的健康信息服务以及医生与用户之间的沟通功能。系统由一个面向会话的控制器来管理问题推进与澄清，并由语言模型辅助进行答案验证。结构化的回答会被传递给独立的风险分析模块，报告则通过Firebase服务与用户及会话记录进行关联。该项目采用多智能体设计，将信息收集、验证、评估与报告生成等功能相互分离。其文档化的验证范围包括45项功能测试规范，涵盖账户管理、问卷交互、报告生成等内容。
tldr: 本文提出了Aegis——一个基于多智能体设计的浏览器端肺癌筛查对话式原型，集成对话式问卷、规则化风险分类、可下载报告、检索增强健康信息与医患沟通功能，并通过45项功能测试规范进行了验证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Aegis, a browser-based multi-agent conversational prototype for lung cancer screening that integrates a dialogue-driven questionnaire, rule-based risk categorization, downloadable reports, retrieval-augmented health information, and doctor-user communication, validated through 45 functional test specifications.
